name: The Hunter's Path

meta.start: Olmin Burningbeard, Tristane Shadowstone, Einris Brightspear

summary: In Dun Morogh, the trainers send ready hunters to Kharanos to begin learning how to tame wild beasts. Grif Wildheart oversees the trials there.

sections.title: A Hunter's True Calling
sections.body: Novice hunters cross Dun Morogh’s snowy crags alone until they learn to bond with beasts. Olmin Burningbeard and Tristane Shadowstone watch their pupils closely. They wait until a hunter can face a savage creature calmly and spare its life. Then the trainers send the disciplined novice down the mountain roads toward Kharanos.

sections.title: Reporting to Grif Wildheart
sections.body: In Kharanos, Grif Wildheart oversees the final trials of dwarven huntsmanship. Taming a beast takes more than bringing it down for meat or pelt. A hunter needs patience, physical endurance, and an instinctive bond with the wild predators of the mountains. Wildheart prepares each hunter to test their will against Dun Morogh’s fiercest wildlife.

faq.q: What is the purpose of this quest?
faq.answer: Ready hunters travel to Kharanos to begin taming trials under Grif Wildheart.

faq.q: Who sends me on this path?
faq.answer: Hunter trainers direct their pupils along this path. They include Olmin Burningbeard in Ironforge's Hall of Arms, Tristane Shadowstone, and Einris Brightspear.

faq.q: Where can I find Grif Wildheart?
faq.answer: Grif Wildheart waits outside the Thunderbrew Distillery in Kharanos, in Dun Morogh's snowy valley.

faq.q: Why do hunters need a trainer to tame beasts?
faq.answer: Hunters use special techniques and a taming rod to commune with wild beasts without provoking a fight to the death. Grif Wildheart teaches these traditions.

faq.q: What happens after reporting to Grif Wildheart?
faq.answer: After you report to Grif Wildheart, he tests your mettle. He sends you into the wilderness with a taming rod to subdue several distinct beasts native to Dun Morogh.

faq.q: Can any hunter take this specific quest?
faq.answer: This summons directs dwarven hunters in Dun Morogh to the local trainer in Kharanos.

angles.text: As a hunter, you begin to leave solitary tracking behind and learn to command wild predators.
As a dwarf, you know mountaineers have long kept bears and boars as trusted scouting companions across Dun Morogh's snowy peaks.
